title: Song
description: A song to make: its words, its sound, and what it is asked to hit.

concept.description: The idea the song is built on and what sets it apart from the stream's other songs, in its writer's words.

style.description: Genre, instruments, mood, and voice in plain words. Never a named artist.

pronounce.description: How a word or name the lines sing is said, when it is not of the song's language or is uncommon: the words as written, each to how it sounds. The style a model reads carries them.

vocal_gender.description: The lead voice, for a model that takes it as its own setting (Mureka's gender) rather than reading it from the style.

byline.description: The artist name on release files.

words_by.description: Who wrote the words: a person, a model (or an agent), or a person editing a model's draft. A release's AI disclosure is read from it.

release.description: What release files carry beyond the title and byline.

cover.description: A square image in the job folder, at least 3000 px a side.

style.description: How this section differs from the rest, in a few words. A model that reads notes on lyric tags gets it there; any other model gets the notes after the style.

energy.description: How much this section carries, from 1 (nearly nothing) to 5 (the song's fullest), as its writer means it. A take is read against it, section by section.

avoid.description: What this section keeps out, in a few words, such as the drums of a quiet intro. A model that takes what to keep out per section (a plan's chunk) gets it there; it is never sent as style.

visual.description: What a lyric video shows here.

bars.description: How many bars the section runs, so a video can start a shot at each one.
